status.description: ok means at least one dimension was rated good, fair or bad, not that the video passes. unassessable requires all dimensions n/a and no findings. Other dimensions may be n/a in a partial assessment.

dimensions.description: good: convincing execution with no meaningful problem; fair: observed limited weakness, main requirement largely works; bad: severe clearly observable failure; n/a: no relevant requirement/content or insufficient evidence to judge. n/a is ungraded. Apply the dimension-specific anchors in the system instruction.

prompt_alignment.description: Original-request requirements: subjects, attributes, relationships, core action and outcome, required text and lines, shot order and requested style. Optional rewrite embellishments are not mandatory.

camera.description: Requested shot and camera move, keeping the action in frame, and stable, purposeful framing and movement appropriate to the intended style.

anatomy.description: Coherent shapes of bodies, faces, hands, animals and props at each visible moment, respecting intentional stylized proportions.

temporal_consistency.description: Identity, object and scene stability over time, through occlusions and across relevant shot transitions.

motion.description: Natural, fluid, coordinated and complete action with appropriate energy and pacing; unintended freezing, stiffness, jerks or loops. Respect requested stop motion and completed-action holds.

physics.description: Visible contact, weight, support, collisions, gravity, fluids, cloth dynamics and causality under the intended physical rules; internally consistent stylized physics is acceptable.

aesthetics.description: Lighting, exposure, materials, color, detail, rendering quality and polish within the intended style; judge both successful presentation and visible rendering flaws.

audio.description: Clean sound, suitable music, clear speech, effects synchronized to events and relevant lip sync. Genuine absence of required sound is a problem; irrelevant or insufficiently assessable audio is n/a.

findings.description: Concise observed weaknesses. Every fair/bad dimension requires a supporting finding; bad requires high-confidence support. No findings for good or n/a dimensions.

id.description: Unique finding identifier within this response.

description.description: The concrete observed problem; no comparisons or speculative causes.

start_s.description: Approximate start in seconds; null together with end_s when localization is unsupported.

end_s.description: Approximate end in seconds, at or after start_s and within the clip; otherwise null together with start_s.

confidence.description: Strength of evidence for this observation, not severity or a calibrated probability.

impact.description: How the problem affects this dimension or the requested result.

repair_goal.description: Desired corrected behavior, not a full rewrite, speculative cause or guaranteed prompt fix.
